phase: Phase 12 production desk + authorized whole-product accuracy closure A02–A08

rules.DESK_TODAY_FRONT_PAGE: Today (today.html) replaces the retired dashboard as the published front page index.html. It renders decision.json (v8.decision/1) through desk.js: Best Trades Now, Emerging, Avoided summary, Portfolio, Funding and System. Presentation only; no engine output changes.
rules.DESK_ANALYZER_PRESENTATION: The Analyzer shows the desk's decision panel first (the same cards as Today, from desk.js), labels price, chart and CoinGecko data as context, prioritises discovery assets in search and fails closed with the desk's wording. Its call is unchanged: the Phase 11 decision alone.
rules.DESK_ANALYZER_SHARED_CORE: analyze.js delegates its Phase 11 authority reading (authority, asset decision, code wording) to desk.js, so TODAY and the Analyzer read one object one way; without a live price no plan is placed. Exports and the call semantics are unchanged.
rules.DESK_SHARED_PRESENTATION_CORE: desk.js (new): the shared presentation core. Reads decision.json and the audit snapshot, validates their shape, labels and escapes; decides nothing (no state, rank, section, authority, identity or portfolio verdict of its own). Phase 12 correction changes only Research evidence presentation and source/provenance validation; Today/Analyzer/Funding/Portfolio semantics remain unchanged.
rules.DESK_DESIGN_SYSTEM: desk.css (new): the desk's one state visual language (TRADE, WATCH, AVOID, MISSING/DEGRADED), responsive layout, focus, reduced motion and dark theme.
rules.DESK_FUNDING_PAGE: funding.html (new): qualified funding_opportunities separated from the evaluated market; never risk-free; no degraded leg is shown.
rules.DESK_PORTFOLIO_CONSOLE: portfolio.html (new): the Phase 10 summary the decision carries, with the audit snapshot's detail only when it is the same evaluation; stress labelled deterministic.
rules.DESK_RESEARCH_PAGE: Research separates current production policy authority from isolated, validated production research evidence; reviewed Phase 9 files are explicitly historical baseline. Current/main-mismatch/last-known-good/baseline/unavailable presentation never grants promotion or changes decisions.
rules.LEGACY_PAGE_DEMOTED_TO_DIAGNOSTIC: picks.html, quant.html, smart.html and the 15-minute radar (radar.html) keep running unchanged as diagnostics: the desk's five-link navigation with no tab current, the desk brand and a note that their scores and calls are not desk decisions and not trade-ready. No number, signal or call on them changes.
rules.ACCURACY_DIAGNOSTIC_COPY: A08 labels only; no scoring or ranking changes.
rules.ACCURACY_QUANT_EXECUTION: A05 continuous completed hourly replay and absolute deadline, explicit observed funding, evidence metadata; completed exits preserve old arithmetic. Open diagnostic mark uses last completed observed bar, not future/forming bar.
rules.ACCURACY_SMART_EXECUTION: A03/A04 explicit execution evidence; no missing midpoint close or ambiguous first-hour qualified return.
rules.ACCURACY_ACCOUNTING_CONTEXT: Dashboard diagnostic move/R copies corrected Quant completed-bar mark/accounting; not a decision authority.

code.base: Swing and day-trade scores for every coin on your DEXs, with a trade plan
code.head: Swing and day-trade scores for every coin on your DEXs, with a hypothetical diagnostic plan

code.base: identity-qualified closed trades only (entry-time VERIFIED_CRYPTO proof)
code.head: closed trades with entry-time VERIFIED_CRYPTO proof AND continuous hourly path / observed funding proof
Closed returns require entry identity AND qualified continuous execution evidence
Diagnostic only: missing entry identity or qualified execution proof

not_allowed: No unlisted delta. Universe, identity, venue filtering, signal definitions, parameters, ordering, ranking and policy thresholds unchanged. Listed source hashes and exact JSON leaves cover approved proposal presentation, strict time/input contracts, execution accounting metadata and diagnostics. Production publication logic unchanged; no merge/deployment.
